GATE RUSH 1.4.0 — THE HUD KIT (js/ui.js, P7). Draft for docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §8 (P10 folds it in).
=====================================================================================================
The HUD kit is a mode's generic HUD. A mode never touches the DOM: it emits these events and listens to two answers. Payload
objects may be reused by the emitter (ui copies them in the listener and writes the DOM in update(), on change only). Everything
is reset at level:start, so a mode only emits what it wants while it runs. Nothing here needs a mode: with no hud:* event the
HUD is byte-for-byte the RUN HUD.

EVENTS IN (mode -> ui)
----------------------
hud:progress { variant, segments, filled, endIcon, label }
  variant   'segments' = the bar becomes `segments` cells (1-6, dividers at k/n); anything else = the run's bar again.
  segments  number of cells.
  filled    0..segments, may be fractional (the fill follows it; level:progress stops moving the bar while segments are on).
            On a portrait box a segments label starts at the bar's left end and sets tighter: "NEXT SURGE 16" clears a 7-digit wallet with Large
            text by 2 px at 320 x 568, so a label should not be longer than that one, and must stay shorter than the bar (it would move the bar).
  endIcon   'skull' | 'barricade' | 'none'. Omitted = unchanged. level:start sets 'barricade' on a level whose script finale is
            'hold', else 'skull'.
  label     the text over the bar ('SURGE 2/3'); '' = 'LEVEL n'.
  Campaign only; endless keeps its metres and mini-boss skull. Extra fields are ignored (hold.js sends boss).

hud:counter { on, text }
  A big line under the bar ('1,240 LEFT', 28 px Lilita). The power-up row, district tag and NEW card drop a row while it shows; under
  the boss bar while that is up. Emit at most 10 Hz. Extra fields are ignored (hold.js sends value).

hud:anchors { n, list: [{ id, x, y, state, label }] }
  Up to 6 bubbles, projected by the mode at 10 Hz. n omitted or < 0 = list.length; n = 0 hides them.
  id     anything; returned as-is in ui:anchorTap (hold.js uses the section index).
  x, y   the bubble's centre in CSS px of #app (render.worldToScreen output).
  state  'repair' | 'rebuild' (green rim, wrench, pulsing halo), 'gap' | 'busy' (amber rim, dim wrench), 'nokits' (red rim, dim wrench,
         a shake), 'info' or any other non-empty string (blue rim); '' = this bubble hidden.
  label  a chip under the bubble ('CLEAR THE GAP', 'NO KITS'); '' = none.
  Size: 56 px; 48 px on landscape phones (max-height 500). Bubbles take no pointer: a drag over them still aims.

hud:action { on, id, icon, label, badge, disabled }
  The round button (64 px minimum), bottom-left, FIRE's mirror. Left-handed (settings.leftHanded, html.left-handed) swaps it with
  FIRE and keeps the hint pill clear of both corners.
  id        returned in ui:action (optional; hold.js sends none).
  icon      an icon-atlas id (RENDER.icons row 2: 'kit', 'kit2', 'airstrike', 'flare', 'supply', and the item ids).
  label     the chip under the button ('REPAIR'); part of its accessible name ("REPAIR · 3").
  badge     the number in the corner; < 0 hides it.
  disabled  grey; a press gives the refusal shake and NO event.

hud:banner { text, kicker, color, seconds }
  A centred card for `seconds` of theatre time (it holds while paused); kicker optional, color 0xRRGGBB (omitted or < 0: the UI
  primary). seconds <= 0 or text '' hides it. The same banner (same kicker and colour) re-emitted while up only changes its text and
  deadline, without popping again ('LINE COLLAPSING 3…2…1').

hud:pill { id, icon, seconds, color }
  A timer pill in the power-up row: icon-atlas `icon` (default id), ring colour 0xRRGGBB (omitted: the item's colour), counting
  on the theatre clock. Re-emit to refresh; seconds <= 0 removes it. The row holds 3 pills, shared with weapons and gear.
hud:pill { id, icon, seconds, text, x, y }
  With `text`: a short label instead ('BREACH!', '+1 KIT') centred on x, y (CSS px of #app) for `seconds`, popping in; 3 at a time,
  round-robin. Added for hold.js's world labels (P6's WIP already emitted this shape); the plan's list has no other DOM path for them.

EVENTS OUT (ui -> mode)
-----------------------
ui:anchorTap { id }   a tap (engine's classifier: < STEER.tapMaxPx, < tapMaxMs, any pointer, a second finger during a drag too) inside
                      a shown bubble, 8 px of slop, nearest bubble wins. Only while playing. The payload is reused.
ui:action { id }      a press of the action button (pointerdown, or Enter on it), only while playing and not disabled. Reused payload.
                      One press is one event, however long it is held: the click after a pointer press never acts, so a mode may
                      spend a resource on every ui:action.

RELATED
-------
Pause with a screen: engine.pause({ brief: key }) -> the paused state shows #scr-brief. ui does this itself on the first playing frame
of a run whose type key has an undone hint 'mode.<key>'. See TYPES-UI-NOTES.txt.
Debug overlay: while ctx.crowd.active, ui appends the crowd line; with ctx.hold.active it reads hold.botView { focusLevel, eased[3],
holdActions }.
CSS: the kit's DOM lives in the TYPES-UI region; P6's region may restyle it for the hold (ids #hud-counter, #hud-anchors > .anchor,
#btn-action, #hud-banner, .hud-label, #progress-segs).
